title: Trump confirms 'more' talks with Iran as Tehran insists on continuing nuclear enrichment
description: The talks, held on Friday in the Gulf Arab state of Oman, marked the first round of negotiations between the two sides since the United States and Israel struck Iran last summer. Delegations from both countries participated in indirect discussions mediated by Oman.

But for the first time, America brought its top military commander in the Middle East to the table. title: US-Iran tensions spike after Oman talks as Trump signals military, economic pressure
description: Tensions between the United States and Iran have escalated after indirect talks in Oman were followed by military posturing and fresh economic measures from Washington. A Zee News DNA analysis highlighted how President Donald Trump’s actions have shifted the outlook from diplomacy towards a heightened risk of confrontation.

title: US-Iran Nuclear Talks Resume In Muscat With Cautious Optimism As Threats Continue
description: United States and Iran reopened indirect nuclear talks in Muscat, with Donald Trump and Iranian minister Abbas Araghchi welcoming progress while warning of serious consequences if diplomacy fails.

title: If Talks Fail: How a US-Iran War Could Pull Israel, Iraq, Yemen And Lebanon In
description: The spectre of heightened conflict between the United States and Iran has returned to the forefront of global security concerns in February 2026 as military and diplomatic developments unfold simultaneously. The US Navy’s USS Abraham Lincoln (CVN-72) — flagship of Carrier Strike Group Three — remains deployed in the Arabian Sea, operating under United States Central Command amid an increasingly fraught strategic backdrop.On Tuesday, a US F-35C Lightning II aircraft intercepted and destroyed an Iranian Shahed-139 drone that was approaching the carrier with “unclear intent,” according to US military officials. The shoot-down occurred without damage to the carrier or its accompanying vessels. Pentagon spokespeople framed the action as a defensive response to protect personnel and assets in international waters.The US military and Iran remain locked in a complex interplay of deterrence and diplomacy. Iran’s armed forces, including the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, have periodically challenged U.S. assets in the region, including harassing a US-flagged tanker in the strategically vital Strait of Hormuz. Regional analysts suggest Tehran’s actions — from drone flights to naval manoeuvres — serve both as strategic signalling toward Washington and as tests of US resolve.

title: Iran FM looks to more nuclear talks, but warns US
description: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said on Saturday he hoped talks with the United States would resume soon, while reiterating Tehran's red lines and warning against any American attack.According to excerpts published on his official Telegram channel during an interview with the Al Jazeera network, Araghchi said that Iran's missile programme was "never negotiable" in Friday's talks in Oman.He warned that Tehran would target US bases in the region if the US attacked Iranian territory.
